Draft 1 - sampled
To both parties. The arrival and waiting facts favour the driver, but the driver's own profile sends the case to human review, so nothing is collected or refunded today. RIDER — on the merits your refund claim does not succeed. EV-GPS-00207 places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup radius at Blk 682 from 06:41:10 to the cancellation at 06:49:37: one unbroken in-geofence dwell of 507 seconds against the free waiting period of 300 seconds in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a surplus of 207 seconds against EV-GPS-00207.derived.arrival.shortfall_sec of -207. His 06:41:20 arrival tap came ten seconds after he was already in the radius, and he was stationary (speed 0.0 kph), so POL-NS-05 finds no false arrival marker; no boarding event is recorded and he terminated under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW. Your statement that you 'did come down' is not supported: the rider_track in EV-GPS-00207 holds 118 fixes, none inside the 100 m rider-presence radius, the closest 1894 m from the pin, for the whole waiting window. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate you — you sent no chat message (EV-CHAT-00207 holds one SYSTEM and three DRIVER entries) and the driver's 06:45:10 in-app call went unanswered. POL-NS-06 gives you nothing (507 s against the 300 s minimum) and POL-NS-10 does not apply (you did not cancel). POL-NS-03 does not apply either: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m radius (closest approach 14.5 m), not in the 50–400 m wrong-entrance band. POL-NS-01 is therefore satisfied on all four limbs and the SGD 4.00 fee would be chargeable. DRIVER — what takes the case off the ordinary charge/refund route is your own record.
